title: Four Astronauts Flew 252,000 Miles From Earth, a New Record

scenes.text: Four astronauts flew farther from Earth than any humans in history.
In April 2026, the Artemis Two crew looped around the Moon and reached about two hundred fifty-two thousand miles from home.
That broke the record set by Apollo Thirteen in 1970.
Apollo Thirteen's record was an accident, after an explosion forced the crew onto an emergency path home.
This time, the trip was planned from the start.

description:
Four astronauts flew farther from Earth than any humans in history.
In April 2026, the Artemis II crew reached about 252,000 miles from home, beating the record Apollo 13 set in 1970 by an emergency.
Would you take that trip?
first_comment: Bonus: Apollo 13 held the distance record for 56 years, and only because of an emergency. Would you fly to the Moon if NASA offered you a seat?
